scope: Test clips; original 5% accuracy-matched Tetris/prior choices, reference, and reported LEAP pattern output
method: Read cached tracks only, reusing the scoring-window audit; no metric or inference rerun. Fresh selected counts match saved configs.json exactly. In-video counts exclude boxes on frames outside the decoded video; all-config totals include these annotation overruns.
all_configurations_count_check: Each configuration matches the saved full-file scoring-window audit exactly; all numerical aggregation uses DuckDB; prediction file tails supply lengths only.
frame_count_scope: GT-positive frames after the final prediction that the scorer ignores, within decoded video bounds; not ordinary false negatives within the scored interval. Repeated counts include a frame once per configuration; unique counts identify (dataset,clip,frame) once if any configuration is affected.
